messages:
ava_prod: Heads-up — launching Hosted API streaming tool-calls GA today with model 'mosaic-mini-q4' and new stream-muxing. Docs & migration guide: https://internal.redwood/devdocs/hosted-stream-toolcall :tada:

 tom_eng: Rollout plan? canary -> regional -> full?

 ava_prod: Canary in us-east for 8h, then EU/APAC staggered over 48h. Legacy header X-Stream-Legacy supported 60 days. Opt-in via X-Redwood-StreamMux: enabled.

 lia_docs: Published docs + quickstart snippets. Will add migration checklist and changelog link.

 ops-bot: canary key 'canary-use-182500' created. Deploy logs: /ops/deploys/1825000000

 tom_eng: SDKs updated to v2.6.2. Samples show streamMux: true. Pin test apps.

 ava_prod: No quota changes. Stream sessions count toward concurrent-streams. Fallback to mosaic-base if capacity tight.

 lia_docs: Example curl in docs. Please surface any regressions here.

 ops-bot: Monitoring dashboards created; alert if toolcall error rate >1% for 5m.

 ava_prod: Thanks team — post any anomalies here.
